label: The Trove
description: What a hoard is made of at arm's length — the material layer of treasure and how each surface returns light.

items.name: coin-slopes
items.text: slopes of mixed coinage settled at their angle of repose, gold, silver and green-crusted bronze in layered drifts, a thin trickle of coins always sliding somewhere out of sight

items.name: crown-drift
items.text: a snagged drift of crowns and circlets around a fallen candelabrum, velvet caps rotted away, gem settings dull with dust until the light finds them

items.name: gem-scatter
items.text: loose uncut gems scattered through the coin like embers through ash, each stone throwing its own small colored spark back toward the flame

items.name: pearl-ropes
items.text: ropes of pearls spilling from a split ivory casket, every pearl carrying its own tiny warped reflection of the single flame

items.name: blade-markers
items.text: jeweled swords thrust point-down into the pile like grave-markers, scabbards long rotted off, gold-wire grips and pommel-stones catching light at head height

items.name: silver-avalanche
items.text: an avalanche of tarnished silver service — ewers, chargers, toppled goblets — black in the hollows and sudden white at the rims where the tarnish has worn through

items.name: king-masks
items.text: hammered gold funeral masks of forgotten kings propped against a chest, serene faces staring upward, each one holding the light differently

items.name: ivory-amber
items.text: carved ivory and lumps of raw amber heaped together, the amber lighting from within wherever the flame stands behind it, insects shadowed inside

items.name: arcane-oddments
items.text: enchanted oddments ticking among the gold — an orrery of unknown planets mid-spin, astrolabes turning to no hand, a caged glass sphere of slow lightning

items.name: tribute-silk
items.text: bolts of rotted tribute silk collapsed under spilled plate, the gold-thread embroidery outliving the cloth it was sewn on
